name: unchained_berserker_cannot_be_targeted_by_a_white_spell_but_can_by_others
notes: Printed: 'Protection from white (This creature can't be ... targeted ... by anything white.)'. Seat 0 holds two copies of the white instant Show of Valor ({1}{W}, +2/+4) and the red instant Infuriate ({R}, +3/+2) with the mana for all three. Show of Valor on the Berserker is refused, the same spell on seat 0's Bear resolves (so the refusal is about the target, not the mana), and the red Infuriate on the Berserker resolves: the 1/1 is 4/3 and the Bear 4/6.
